 [Vocational] Scouts can find employment in a variety of settings. Their
 general duties include travelling in front of a group for the purposes of
 finding hazards and/or dangers for the rest of the group to avoid. Time to
 Acquire: 33 months. Starting Money: normal plus d10 (open-ended).
